description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the UserContext component in the OpenMRS project, specifically testing default location retrieval based on user properties and their handling of valid and invalid IDs or UUIDs.

classes.name: UserContextTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying behavior of UserContext in OpenMRS, focusing on default location retrieval.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Sets up test data by creating a Person and a User before each test.

methods.name: deleteUser
methods.description: Cleans up test data by deleting the created User and Person after each test.

methods.name: getDefaultLocationId_shouldGetDefaultLocationById
methods.description: Tests that the default location ID is correctly retrieved when set directly by ID.

methods.name: getDefaultLocationId_shouldGetDefaultLocationByUuid
methods.description: Tests that the default location ID is correctly retrieved when set by UUID.

methods.name: getDefaultLocationId_shouldReturnNullForInvalidId
methods.description: Verifies that an invalid numeric ID yields a null default location.

methods.name: getDefaultLocationId_shouldReturnNullForInvalidUuid
methods.description: Verifies that an invalid UUID yields a null default location.
